source: Sanitized projection of the private CAH rerun record. Private task-state, account, conversation, host-path and raw-log fields are omitted.

terminal_disposition.note: The user explicitly stopped further Phase-2B work after the G32 physical Worker attempt stalled without a durable semantic result. Native direct-preview acceptance is not claimed.

semantic_pixel_qa.note: The intended retro camera was clearly readable in native Lit captures. No severe missing-shader, checkerboard, placeholder, all-black, exploded, clipped or missing-geometry defect was accepted.
semantic_pixel_qa.limitation: The viewport background remained visibly black. Phase 1 was accepted because the model itself was readable and the low/bottom inspection path was floor-free.

fresh_requirements: new source/build tree for the rerun
fresh UE 5.6.1 build and runtime smoke
integration against the rerun's fresh Cook
reconstruction.runtime_path_change: Older dynamic-loader and simple Content/Paks staging assumptions failed on the fresh Cook; the accepted integration moved to a fresh packaged Viewer using Pak-only/no-IoStore mode and the real external camera shader library.
reconstruction.interpretation: The accepted P1 Viewer is a fresh reconstruction informed by historical design/source knowledge, not an old binary reuse, old-result replay, or simple copy-and-rebuild.

accepted_findings.same_path_collision: The default combined provider selected a base-game PatchPak candidate at an equal read order; successful logical-path export alone did not prove MOD provenance.

phase2a.conclusion: Phase 2A accepted package/dependency reconnaissance and established that later Viewer work must intentionally select the MOD member rather than trust default equal-order provider behavior.

historical_native_screenshots.note: Previously published Viewer screenshots remain preserved in the pre-clean public commit for historical comparison. The four 2026-09-28 accepted Phase-1 rerun captures are now published directly in this showcase under images/ and retain the exact identities recorded in phase1.captures.

claims_not_made: publication of the UE-linked Viewer module

part_framing.interpretation: Part 1 is the positive long-running stability case. Part 2 is a real-task recovery stress record: intervention #1 after G9 improves infrastructure resilience; that improvement is exercised when G12 wedges primary execution but G13-G15 continue on backup capacity; intervention #2 upgrades Helper after the post-G15 recovery path fails to close; the task then continues unattended through G31 before G32 exposes a different physical web-conversation failure.

recovery_stress_timeline.detail: Worker-authored staged runtime wrapper synchronously nested the Viewer launcher without an outer watchdog/timeout and reliable cleanup.
Worker retention/binding path was repaired while preserving the same semantic task.
The Helper recovery contract was strengthened during the live incident before the same Parent Task resumed.

areas: stronger semantic Helper recovery ownership and return-control semantics

stability_metrics.workload_description: Concrete engineering task involving fresh Blender/UE work, Viewer reconstruction, native acceptance, Build/Cook, package/runtime investigation and direct-preview research.
stability_metrics.interpretation: Nearly ten hours of real-task operation elapsed before the first system-level failure required human recovery. With only two human recovery interventions, the same Parent Task continued producing durable progress for 17h47m56s through G31. The later G32 physical-page stall is excluded from productive uptime.

intervention_1.effect: Recovery infrastructure hotfix around G10, including backup/redundant execution capacity, semantic-sync/durable-result reduction, retention/binding and lifecycle fixes.

g12_validation_of_intervention_1.interpretation: G12 again blocks primary execution, but G13-G15 continue on backup capacity, demonstrating that intervention #1 improved resilience.

intervention_2.trigger: After G15 durable completion, Planner invokes Helper for the inherited G12 incident; first Helper behavior cannot complete recovery closure.
intervention_2.name: Helper Hotfix 2.0
intervention_2.effect: Helper becomes a closure-complete recovery owner capable of bounded mutation, cleanup verification, durable incident/result, canonical closure and return-control.
